title: [physics-loop] Block26 finite lease tensor and convex collision channels — bounded_theorem / conditional-support
science: CONDITIONAL-FINITE-LEASE-TENSOR-AND-PHYSICAL-CONVEX-COLLISION-CHANNELS-POSITIVE — defeats the #7811 wall by going stochastic instead of sharp, and does so with unusual self-discipline. (1) Finite disjoint-carrier tensorization: for any SUPPLIED finite family of pairwise-disjoint complete 224-site carriers, the tensor product of the complete translated Block24 channels (all 1,176 physical success branches per anchor plus the literal K_STOP = I - P_valid, grouped into 84 current-Record control rows of 14 outcomes each summing to one) is exactly CPTP, sum over multi-index of K^dag K = tensor of I_a, proved by positive-n induction with the local factor bound to the actual imported channel rather than a stored Gram value; it survives an arbitrary untouched reference coefficientwise, is order independent (disjoint factors commute), is projectively consistent (omitting an anchor returns the lower-family channel), is covariant under translation and all 24 frames, keeps old Records QND, and debits exactly one declared forward Blank block per success. (2) Overlap does NOT prevent a physical collision-safe channel: for the exact Block25 q=1/4 pair (anchors (0,0,0) and (-19,-1,0), targets (-9,0,0) and (-10,-1,0)) the equal convex mixture of the two complete channels including both STOP families is CPTP, and every realized Kraus trajectory appends zero or one new Locked Record, NEVER two; the winner is decoded from the emitted physical Locked word (source anchor plus front) rather than from any abstract owner bit, and STOP creates no owner. On the E_11 principal two-projector fiber the effects F_A = P/2, F_B = Q/2, F_0 = I - (P+Q)/2 sum to identity with exact spec(F_0) = {1/4, 3/4} and ray weights (1/2, 1/8, 3/8); the scalar ansatz I - w(P+Q) has maximal positivity-preserving w_* = 1/lambda_max(P+Q) = 2/3, where the residual is positive, singular and nonzero — a normalization boundary for that ansatz, not an arbitration obstruction. (3) The channel is routed through the four commuting old-Record presence sectors E_00/E_10/E_01/E_11 (identity, full A channel, full B channel, equal mixture) with Gram sum_s E_s^2 sum_o w_(s,o) = sum_s E_s = I, so a lone claimant gets the FULL singleton channel rather than an attenuated half-mixture. (4) All 63 nonempty subsets of the six-front exact-common-target geometry admit the covariant 1/|S| mixture Psi_S writing exactly one of 84 mutually orthogonal Locked winner words on the declared all-valid/common-Blank sector. (5) Exemplary negative discipline: the block HAD a deterministic negative (on the swap-invariant pair descriptor only grants 00 and 11 are equivariant-invariant, mutual exclusion leaves only 00 which lacks exactly-one liveness; the three-cycle edgewise binary diagnostic is likewise inconsistent) and DEMOTED it to a finite descriptor classification after its own N1-N8 stochastic steelman succeeded — the no-go gate returns FAIL for a general arbitration negative and none ships. (6) Concrete renewal boundary that defines the terminal PR problem: initial disjointness is not a renewal theorem — two complete carriers separated by 27 e_1 are disjoint, but after the displayed inward return their carriers overlap on 64 sites even though the two target blocks remain disjoint.
